def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # The 2x2 zero marker identifies two rows and two columns to clear.
    r=c=None
    for i in range(h-1):
        for j in range(w-1):
            if all(grid[x][y]==0 for x in (i,i+1) for y in (j,j+1)):
                r,c=i,j
                break
        if r is not None: break
    if r is None: return out
    for i in range(h):
        for j in (c,c+1): out[i][j]=0
    for i in (r,r+1):
        for j in range(w): out[i][j]=2 if grid[i][j]==2 else 0
    return out
